cues: Alcohols show four kinds of isomerism: chain, position, functional, with ethers of the same formula, and optical.
C four H ten O has four alcohols: butan one ol, butan two ol, two methyl propan one ol, and two methyl propan two ol.
Butan two ol has a carbon with four different groups, so it is chiral.
